must_have_properties: Hardware shall return 0 for all bits and registers marked as Reserved.
Software shall write all reserved bits and registers with the value 0.
Register accesses shall have a maximum size of 64 bits.
64-bit register accesses shall not cross an 8-byte alignment boundary.
Locked accesses to memory-mapped AHCI registers are not supported.
AHCI memory-mapped registers shall reside in non-cacheable memory space.
Bit field naming convention shall be Register Symbol.Field Symbol (e.g. PxCMD.ST).
If CAP.SAM = 0, GHC.AE shall be RW with reset 0; if CAP.SAM = 1, GHC.AE shall be RO 1.
Software shall set GHC.AE = 1 before accessing other AHCI registers when CAP.SAM = 0.
When clearing GHC.AE from 1 to 0, software shall write 0x00000000 to GHC (no other bits set).
PI shall have at least one bit set.
Number of set bits in PI shall not exceed CAP.NP + 1.
Software shall not read or write registers within unavailable ports (PI bit cleared).
Each port shall implement registers PxCLB, PxCLBU (if S64A=1), PxFB, PxFBU (if S64A=1), PxIS, PxIE, PxCMD, PxTFD, PxSIG, PxSSTS, PxSCTL, PxSERR, PxSACT, PxCI.
AHCI 1.3 + HBAs shall implement PxSNTF (when CAP.SSNTF=1), PxFBS (when CAP.FBSS=1).
AHCI 1.3.1 HBAs shall implement PxDEVSLP register when CAP2.SDS=1.
Each implemented port's Command List shall be 1 KB aligned.
Each implemented port's Received FIS Structure shall be 256 B aligned (or 4 KB aligned when PxFBS.EN=1).
Each Command Header shall be 32 B; up to 32 Command Headers per port (CAP.NCS+1).
Each Command Table shall be 128 B aligned.
Command FIS Length (CFL) shall be 2..16 Dwords; values 0 and 1 are illegal.
PRD entries shall be 16 B each; up to 65,535 PRDs per Command Table.
PRD DBA shall be word-aligned (bit 0 reserved).
PRD DBC shall represent an even byte count (bit 0 always 1); maximum 4 MB per PRD entry.
FIS payload shall be protected by 32-bit CRC, polynomial 0x04C11DB7, defined by Serial ATA 2.6.
VS register for 1.3.1-compliant HBA shall read 0x00010301.
Class Code shall be 0x010601 (Mass Storage / SATA / AHCI v1).
PxCMD.ST shall be set to 1 only after PxCMD.FRE has been set to 1.
Software shall clear PxCMD.ST to 0 and wait for PxCMD.CR = 0 before clearing PxCMD.FRE.
Software shall not modify PxCLB / PxCLBU / PxFB / PxFBU while PxCMD.ST = 1 or PxCMD.FRE = 1.
HBA shall maintain Task File shadow in PxTFD (STS + ERR) updated by every D2H Register FIS.
PxSACT[slot] shall only be cleared by HBA on a Set Device Bits FIS with the matching SActive bit set.
PxCI[slot] shall be cleared by HBA on command completion (D2H Register FIS with I=1 for non-NCQ; CFIS transmit complete for NCQ).
Software-initiated port reset shall hold PxSCTL.DET = 1 for at least 1 ms.
PxCMD.ICC = 8h (DevSleep) shall only be honored when CAP2.SDS = 1 AND PxDEVSLP.DSP = 1.
When CAP.CCCS = 1, IS.IPS[CCC_CTL.INT] shall be the CCC interrupt vector and that port shall be Reserved in PI.
must_not_have_properties: Software shall not issue locked transactions to AHCI memory-mapped registers.
Software shall not access registers within unimplemented ports (PI bit 0).
Software shall not set PxCMD.ST while PxCMD.FRE = 0.
Software shall not modify PxCLB / PxFB while DMA engine is running (CR=1).
HBA shall not split a single FIS across multiple link-layer transactions.
HBA shall not generate spurious interrupts when GHC.IE = 0.
BOHC.OOS shall not transition without BOHC.OOC also being set by hardware.
Once a non-zero value is written to PxCMD.ICC, the field shall self-clear to 0h Idle after the transition completes.

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Hardware behavior undefined — software must always write reserved bits 0.
Indeterminate behavior; port may not advance Command List.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: PxCLB / PxFB modified while CR=1 or FRE=1
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Memory corruption — HBA may DMA to stale address.

compliance_failure_modes.mode: Setting GHC.AE=0 with other GHC bits set in same write
Software waits for PxCI clear after issuing NCQ command without checking PxSACT
compliance_failure_modes.trigger: NCQ completion is signaled by PxSACT clear via SDB FIS, not by PxCI alone.
Receiver returns R_ERR; PxSERR.ERR.DataIntegrity / .CRC + PxIS.IFS or PxIS.INFS.
Up to 64 B copied to UFIS; PxSERR.DIAG.F + PxIS.UFS.
Device delivered more bytes than PRDT total; PxIS.OFS.
FIS from a PMP with no outstanding command; PxIS.IPMS.

fields.reset_behavior_compliance: HBA Reset (GHC.HR=1) resets all state machines + IS + per-port runtime state to reset values; PI is HwInit-loaded; BOHC is unaffected; CAP / CAP2 / VS are RO HwInit and not affected. Port Reset (PxSCTL.DET=1 → 0) performs COMRESET → COMINIT → COMWAKE → ALIGN-lock → speed negotiation → L0 → device sends D2H Register FIS with signature loaded into PxSIG; clears Task File shadow PxTFD via the D2H Register FIS. Software Reset (SRST sequence — two CFISes with R=1 + SRST=1 then SRST=0) only resets device-side state, not the SATA link.
fields.min_clock_constraint: AHCI itself does not specify a minimum register-access clock; the host bus (PCI / PCIe) defines that. The SATA Transport / Link / PHY layers (defined in Serial ATA 2.6) define line-rate minima — Gen 1: 1.5 GHz embedded clock; Gen 2: 3 GHz; Gen 3: 6 GHz; OOB envelope detector operates at the reference-clock frequency (typically 25-100 MHz).
